### REQ-001: ArduinoJson ESP-IDF component

## Requirement

Add ArduinoJson v7 as a managed ESP-IDF component so that existing JSON serialization and deserialization code from the legacy Arduino codebase can be reused without rewriting. ArduinoJson is framework-agnostic C++ and works with ESP-IDF without modification.

This is a prerequisite for all modules that handle configuration and MQTT message parsing (Message, Configurable, Room, Thermo).

#### Integration method

Add ArduinoJson via the ESP-IDF component manager (`idf_component.yml`) or as a vendored component under `espidf/components/`. The `ARDUINOJSON_ENABLE_STD_STRING 1` define must be set project-wide so `std::string` serialization works as in the legacy code.

## Notes

ArduinoJson is a header-only library. The simplest integration path is the component manager. Alternatively, clone into `espidf/components/arduinojson/`.
